qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Local food delivery marketplace density does not generate durable pricing power or switching barriers; consumer and merchant multi-homing is rampant, and 5-year median GAAP ROIC is deeply negative amidst heavy promotional subsidies.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Proof of Moat). Long history of GAAP operating losses and deeply negative 5-year median ROIC. Lacks structural pricing power due to low customer loyalty, merchant multi-homing, high marketing subsidies, and escalating regulatory pressure on gig-economy courier models.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-year GAAP net income has been consistently negative with cumulative net losses exceeding several billion euros over the last 5 years. Only achieved positive group FCF (~€100M) in FY24 after aggressive cost cuts and capital restructuring. Relies on subsidiary divestments and listings (e.g. Talabat in UAE) rather than organic self-funding economic moats.
